unfold.unfolded: Suppose that $G$ is almost simple and that $J$ and $J'$ are proper subsets of $I$. Then there exists $j\in I$ with $j\notin J'$ such that $w_{J'}(\alpha_j)\notin\Phi_J$.
notes: w_{J'}, Φ_J, α_j and I are not defined in the context, so they are kept as the paper writes them.
The statement gives only j notin J', so I read j as an index in I, the set of simple roots, since it names α_j.

verdict.reason: The index j is implicitly in I because α_j is indexed by I. The unfolded form makes this explicit and otherwise preserves the hypotheses and conclusion.
